test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per the Economic Survey, 2024–25, under which housing scheme were over 89 lakh houses completed in urban areas as of 25 November 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)** is a flagship mission launched by the Government of India in **June 2015** to address the housing needs of the urban population.
 
• The scheme focuses on providing **“Housing for All”** by the year **2022**, targeting the economically weaker sections (EWS), low-income groups (LIG), and middle-income groups (MIG).
 
• As per the **Economic Survey 2024–25**, under the PMAY-U, over **89 lakh houses were completed** in urban areas as of **25 November 2024**.
 
• The scheme operates through four verticals: **In-situ Slum Redevelopment (ISSR)**, **Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS)**, **Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP)**, and **Beneficiary-led Individual House Construction/Enhancement (BLC)**.
 
• Implementation is done in collaboration with **state governments** and **urban local bodies (ULBs)**, ensuring that housing provisions are tailored to regional needs and preferences.
